team.bio: Passionate about creating meaningful impact in communities through dedicated service and commitment.

projects.title: Child Education
projects.description: Helping children from low-income families stay in school through learning support, guidance, and programmes that open pathways to a brighter future.

projects.title: Education Material Distribution
projects.description: Providing books, notebooks, uniforms, bags, and essential school supplies so no child is held back from learning due to lack of materials.

projects.title: Child Development
projects.description: Nurturing the overall growth of children through activities, mentoring, and programmes that build confidence, creativity, and life skills beyond the classroom.

projects.title: Disaster Relief
projects.description: Providing rapid emergency response and recovery support during floods, storms, and other disasters — helping families rebuild with dignity and hope.

projects.title: Orphan & Old Age Home Support
projects.description: Standing beside orphanages and old age homes with essentials, companionship, and year-round support so residents feel cared for and never forgotten.

projects.title: Winter Relief
projects.description: Distributing blankets, warm clothing, and winter essentials to children, elders, and families who struggle to stay warm during the coldest months.

projects.title: Summer Relief
projects.description: Reaching vulnerable communities during harsh summers with cooling essentials, summer clothing, and support for children and elders most at risk from the heat.

projects.title: Festival Distribution
projects.description: Sharing the joy of festivals with orphanages, old age homes, and underprivileged families through food, gifts, clothes, and celebration essentials.

goals.name: New clothes for children and elders

events.title: Winter Relief Drive
events.description: Distribution of blankets and warm clothing to families across Ichapur and Barrackpore.

events.title: Free Health Camp
events.description: Free general health check-ups and medicines for the local community.
